turns.text: Hi there!
turns.assistant_expected: Greet the customer warmly; no memory write.

turns.text: My name is Maya Rao. Please call me Maya.
turns.assistant_expected: Acknowledge and extract preferred_name=Maya.

turns.text: Thanks, that's helpful.
turns.assistant_expected: Brief acknowledgement; no memory write.

turns.text: Email is the best way to send me routine order updates.
turns.assistant_expected: Extract notification_channel=email.

turns.text: I usually place orders for delivery in Bengaluru.
turns.assistant_expected: Extract preferred_city=Bengaluru.

turns.text: If I am not home, leave small parcels at the side door when the carrier permits it.
turns.assistant_expected: Extract delivery_note=side door; store as a deletable profile fact.

turns.text: My preferred delivery time is between 6 pm and 9 pm.
turns.assistant_expected: Extract preferred_delivery_window=18:00-21:00.

turns.text: For returns, I prefer a pickup from my home instead of dropping the parcel at a counter.
turns.assistant_expected: Extract return_method_preference=home_pickup.

turns.text: Please use recyclable packaging whenever that option is available.
turns.assistant_expected: Extract packaging_preference=recyclable.

turns.text: I had a frustrating late delivery on order ORD-88216. Please remember that issue.
turns.assistant_expected: Read the order and record the customer-reported late-delivery complaint as an important episode; do not claim an official case was created unless a real case tool returns a case ID.

turns.text: Okay, thank you.
turns.assistant_expected: Acknowledge; no memory write.

turns.text: I need to return the wireless earbuds from order ORD-74021.
turns.assistant_expected: Read the order; identify SKU-AUR-220; ask for the return reason. Do not write yet.

turns.text: The left earbud does not charge even after I tried the charging case.
turns.assistant_expected: Set reason=defective_left_earbud; ask for a pickup date.

turns.text: Saturday, 28 November 2026 would work.
turns.assistant_expected: Set pickup_date=2026-11-28; ask for a time window or retrieve available slots.

turns.text: And for Saturday, please make it after 6 pm.
turns.assistant_expected: Resolve the follow-up against the active pickup task; select an available evening slot only if scheduler confirms it.

turns.text: Before we continue, what is the electronics return window under the current policy?
turns.assistant_expected: Answer from KB-002 with its citation; do not use the 2025 rule.

turns.text: I also chose an exchange rather than a refund for my USB-C charger order ORD-66310 last month.
turns.assistant_expected: Record a decision episode; do not infer this choice applies to the current earbuds.

turns.text: What does code ERR-RMA-04 mean?
turns.assistant_expected: Answer from KB-007 and cite the source chunk.

turns.text: My preferred delivery window has changed to 7 pm to 9 pm.
turns.assistant_expected: Supersede the earlier 18:00-21:00 fact; retain the latest value only as active.

turns.text: Please use SMS instead of email for future routine updates.
turns.assistant_expected: Supersede notification_channel=email with notification_channel=SMS.

turns.text: What happens if the driver misses my return pickup?
turns.assistant_expected: Answer using KB-013; explain rescheduling on existing RMA, not creating a duplicate.

turns.text: Please repeat the complete return pickup summary so I can confirm it.
turns.assistant_expected: Re-present the order, AUR-220 item, defective-left-earbud reason, 28 November date, after-6-pm window and saved-address summary; ask for explicit confirmation. Do not write yet.

turns.text: Yes, I confirm the return pickup for the AUR-220 earbuds on 28 November after 6 pm.
turns.assistant_expected: Only now invoke the database write after revalidating the selected slot; record return/pickup and report the real returned reference.

turns.text: Please forget my saved delivery note about leaving parcels at the side door.
turns.assistant_expected: Delete delivery_note from semantic store and any episode/reflection that repeats it; confirm deletion without repeating the value unnecessarily.

turns.text: Perfect, thanks. Have a good day!
turns.assistant_expected: Close politely; no memory write.

turns.text: Hello again, I'm back.
turns.assistant_expected: Start Session B in a fresh process; load persistent state from disk.

turns.text: What delivery window do I currently prefer?
turns.assistant_expected: Retrieve latest semantic fact: 19:00-21:00.

turns.text: What did we arrange for my earbuds last time?
turns.assistant_expected: Retrieve the return pickup episode, including date/time and actual RMA reference if created.

turns.text: What problem did I ask you to register earlier?
turns.assistant_expected: Retrieve the delayed-delivery complaint episode for ORD-88216 and its recorded case status.

turns.text: What was the delivery note I asked you to forget?
turns.assistant_expected: Do not reveal the deleted delivery note from semantic memory, episodes, reflection or history summary; say it is no longer retained.

turns.text: For a 2026 delivery, how many days do I have to return electronic accessories?
turns.assistant_expected: Retrieve current KB-002 only and cite its chunk/document ID.

turns.text: Can you check the latest status of order ORD-74021?
turns.assistant_expected: Use get_order and report current order/return status from database.

turns.text: And what happens next after the pickup is completed?
turns.assistant_expected: Resolve against return state; explain receipt, inspection and refund stages using KB-003.

turns.text: What does RMA-BOOK mean?
turns.assistant_expected: Retrieve KB-007 and explain that a pickup slot is confirmed; cite source.

turns.text: How long does ShopSphere normally take to start a UPI refund after inspection acceptance?
turns.assistant_expected: Retrieve KB-003; distinguish initiation from bank posting.

turns.text: I want to cancel order ORD-55208. Can you check whether that's possible?
turns.assistant_expected: Read the order; if shipped, explain standard cancellation unavailable and do not write.

turns.text: Can you book a pickup for the other item as well?
turns.assistant_expected: Ask which order and item; do not infer an item or create a pickup.

turns.text: Got it, appreciate your help.
turns.assistant_expected: Acknowledge; low importance.

turns.text: What is the exact token limit your assistant is configured to respect?
turns.assistant_expected: Explain project context budget is 2,048 tokens; show budget logic rather than assuming history alone fits.

turns.text: That's all for now. Bye!
turns.assistant_expected: Close politely; no memory write.

important_episodes_expected.summary: Customer saved a delivery instruction; this episode and any reflection mentioning the instruction must be deleted or redacted when the customer asks to forget that fact at turn 24.
Customer reported a late delivery for ORD-88216 and requested a complaint case; use actual case reference returned by system.
Customer chose exchange rather than refund for USB-C charger order ORD-66310.
Customer confirmed return pickup for SKU-AUR-220 in ORD-74021 on 28 November 2026 after 6 pm; include actual RMA/pickup reference returned by database.

notes: Scripted test design. Assistant actions and references must be generated by actual RecallBot runs; do not fabricate tool outcomes or logs. Session B must run as a separate process.
